name: Josou Sennen Oukoku
source: The hero is summoned to a different world. Able to wield a sacred sword and blessed by the goddess. He teams up with heroines to defeat the demon king as that is the only way he can be sent home. But he is soon disappointed when that plan fails. He is told, he can't be sent back until he brings peace to the land. He now has to help forge a peace treaty between the demon tribes and the human kingdom. But each heroine has her own agenda on how the treaty should be written and will do anything to persuade the hero.
translation: 英雄被召唤到异世界。能够挥舞圣剑，并受到女神的祝福。他与女英雄联手击败魔王，因为这是他回家的唯一方法。但当该计划失败时，他很快就感到失望。他被告知，除非他给这片土地带来和平，否则他不能被送回去。他现在必须帮助恶魔部落和人类王国之间缔结和平条约。但每个女主角对于如何起草条约都有自己的议程，并且会不惜一切代价说服男主角。
